# Labels

| Label | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `type:feature`, `type:bug`, `type:performance`, `type:docs`, `type:test`, `type:chore` | Kind of change |
| `area:parsing`, `area:formatting`, `area:encoding`, `area:serialization` | Library area |
| `area:benchmarks`, `area:ci`, `area:tooling` | Engineering area |
| `priority:critical`, `priority:high`, `priority:medium`, `priority:low` | Priority |
| `status:ready`, `status:in-progress`, `status:blocked` | Workflow state |
| `agent:ready`, `agent:working`, `agent:review` | Agent workflow state |
| `dependencies` | Dependabot updates |
